name: web-teal-arrow-chevron-gradient-background
title: Teal gradient background with layered translucent arrow-chevron shapes pointing right
whatItIs: A horizontal teal gradient background with two overlapping translucent chevron/arrow shapes pointing right, darker at the edges and brighter cyan at the tip, leaving open space on the right for text.
whatItMeans: Directional and calm; the arrow shapes quietly suggest forward motion or progress without any text.
techniques: Layer translucent chevrons for depth without clutter.
Brighten a shape's tip to draw the eye in one direction.
Leave open negative space for a headline to sit later.

vocabulary.definition: Empty area left deliberately for content or breathing room.
